selection_proposal.reason: 空排除集合（保守结论）。依据 ev_aff5742e2d29e6b726bb：eligible_box_ids 为空，即程序按预注册门槛核验后没有任何 box 达到可排除资格，故不能扩大范围。粗对比逐 box（0–5）细看也无支持排除方向：UniformRef 与 BestCombo 的保留代价（保留 RMSD 减原生关闭 RMSD）在 box 0、1、2、3、5 均为负值，即保留优于原生关闭；box 4 的 BestCombo 粗估为 +0.00059，远低于 material_threshold 0.01，属噪声级且区间跨零，不构成有害证据。低档挽救（LowerRescue_0–5）与 EarlyUpperRescue 同样未出现稳定的正代价，多数落在阈值以下或区间跨零，方向冲突，按规则应保留而非强行排除。完整 50 背景 UniformRef 0.5035 Å 与 BestCombo 0.4925 Å 均为完整、ranking_eligible，BestCombo 略优但差异很小，两个背景都未提示某 box 的额外条件操作有害；BestCombo 的 built/connected 48/50 为工程性完备度差异，不能作为把某 box 判为有害的证据。高档位移（如 box 0 早期窗口最大单原子增量）属单次高档失稳类证据，按规则不足以否定整个 box。因此本轮不排除任何 box，保留全部现有条件操作；不声称对全 scale 有独立验证。

selection_final.reason: eligible_box_ids is empty, so no exclusion is permitted and none is proposed. Coarse paired contrasts vs native-off (10 paired slots each) show retained-minus-native-off retention costs that are negative or negligible for every box: box0 UniformRef -0.1656, BestCombo -0.2292, lower-rescue and EarlyUpperRescue also negative; box1 UniformRef -0.0377, BestCombo -0.0996; box2 -0.0687 / -0.0369; box3 -0.0110 / -0.0221; box5 -0.0140 / -0.0267. Only box4 BestCombo shows a positive value (+0.00059), far below the material threshold (0.01) with a cluster interval spanning zero, i.e. approximate equivalence rather than harm. Lower-rescue variants and EarlyUpperRescue do not reverse these directions, and no background/scale counterexample indicates uniform harm. Positive seed counts are mixed and no box shows a consistent positive cost across seeds; finite-but-unstable single high-scale displacement in the 0-10 window is not evidence of box-level harm. full_contrasts is empty and no joint gating was confirmed, so the conservative default (retain all boxes, no extra conditional operation changes) applies. Selected confirmed complete 50 profile: BestCombo, the lower-RMSD (0.4925 vs 0.5035 A) primary background, with the same empty confirmed exclusion set.
